entries.ontology: Coefficient estimator for the density-visible acoustic pole, not a new state or experimental calibration
entries.observable: conditional coefficient estimates from three energies
entries.claim_boundary: Finite-q interpolation estimates coefficients with bias; not automatically asymptotic or physically validated

entries.ontology: Prospective input covariance, not stochastic dynamics or an assigned instrument noise
entries.units: log input ratios:1; covariance retains coefficient/native units
entries.claim_boundary: Common multiplicative axes cancel in unit-free ratio only; nonlinear distortions, resolution and material uncertainty remain

entries.ontology: Sufficient bounded-relative-energy-error envelope at exact q and fixed rational tree inputs, not laboratory feasibility
entries.equation: |beta_hat_k/c-u_k|<=T_k+eps*N_k; T_k=sum|W_ki|*B_i, N_k=sum|W_ki|*(P_i+B_i); interval r=beta0*beta2/beta1^2 tested against exact target-I ratio interval
entries.claim_boundary: Bound is sufficient, conservative and energy-only; its failure is not a physical no-go or proof of estimator infeasibility
